text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the wayyy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (We were never able to do much for the holidays. But ya know what?)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (They were still cozy 'n fun. The kiddos had a great time too…)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (This year, though…)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (I'm in hell… Hahaha… My own personal hell…)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nghhh… I can't… eat. Not even a single stinkin' bite…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's mid-December and Tamamo Cross, crushed by the ever-mounting pressure, has completely lost her appetite.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why? Why's this happenin' to me… We're so close…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon dummy, ya know how to eat… Just hold in there a liiittle longer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unless she consumes some calories, both training and racing will be completely out of the question. Tamamo Cross is in a real bind.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: If I don't eat, I'm not gonna be able to push myself. And if I don't push myself, I'm never gonna beat her…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I just wanna fight her with everythin' I got! That's all I want!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aw man… Sorry my body's not cooperatin'… I gotta figure this out somehow…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sheer will isn't going to solve this. On the contrary, getting anxious will only weaken her appetite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At this rate, she'll drop out of the running before she's even had the chance to try her best, and her legacy will be one of failure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I leap into action for Tamamo Cross's sake—not as her trainer, but as her partner.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Tamtam's trainer. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. You've managed to pinpoint one of my hidey-holes. That's quite the accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: So, who might you be? And how may I help?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding dong!
Coming! Who is—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Mother
text_block_list.text: W-wait, aren't you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I run around every possible place I can think of. Then, one day in late December…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sorry to disturb ya, Trainer… But I'm not in the mood for a party right now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There's only one thing I want right now, and it's not somethin' you can wrap up with a ribbon on top.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And I really don't think I could stomach even the sight of chicken 'n cake, so… just lemme get some rest…
choice_data_list: Take a look at the table.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The heck is this spread? There isn't a single festive dish here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It just looks like some regular ol' meal. No decorations either…
choice_data_list: Try some. Just have as much as you can.
Try some. Just have as much as you can.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, ya know I've only been managin' a single mouthful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My investigative prowess, my analytical skills, and even my sincerity were put to the test, but I've done it. I've created the humblest holiday meal in the world.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right. Here goes nothin'…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross places a morsel in her mouth…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This tastes… familiar. Not that familiar… but still…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's delicious. And I'm not havin' any trouble gettin' it down…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I wanna eat it. Smells real good too. What the heck did ya serve me here…
choice_data_list: Glad you like it. Eat up!
Glad you like it. Eat up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Yeah! I'm gonna dig right in!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch! Crunch, slurp! What the heck?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I thought of everything. Nutrition, Tamamo's tastes, her condition… All the angles I could possible cover.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I put my whole heart and mind into this dinner. Let's just hope it's enough to sate her stomach.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I finally feel full… Like even my soul is content.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: How'd ya manage to cook this up? To make this kinda meal… ya have to be thinkin' of someone with all your heart…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You… figured everythin' out. My mom's flavors 'n my preferences. Everythin' I need is right here…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And ya made this all… for me…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I was wrong 'bout somethin'. Remember me sayin' there was nothin' ya could give me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, that was a lie. 'Cause deep down…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I think… this is what I really wanted. Somethin' that'd pull me back up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah… My strength lies in my "hunger." But…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nobody can live on an empty tummy—not even me! And yet, I thought…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I couldn't win unless I had that hunger… So I threw myself down a hole so deep, not even my family's warmth could reach me…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nothin' could break through all the darkness.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But this meal—your heart—broke through. Even after I closed myself off from the world… this meal gave me strength.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It helped me see… You and my folks at home… You're all watchin' over me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No matter how far away it sometimes feels, as long as there's that light shining through the starving darkness…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I can run all the way! I can make it through the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt. I can feel it—Tamamo Cross might have felt herself sinking into the depths of despair, but now one last ray of hope shines down on her.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we only got a few days left. I want ya to keep rustlin' me up dishes like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: With this feelin' I got and your full support, I know I can pull through!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll be a lightnin' bolt that strikes faster than Oguri Cap can run! So, please…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The powdery snow flutters down from above like confetti, celebrating the return of the White Lightning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunderclouds crackle. A lightning bolt falls from the sky, but at the last second… it shoots back up into the heavens like a dragon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunderclouds crackle. A lightning bolt falls from the sky, but at the last second… it shoots back up into the heavens like a dragon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha, nothin' like a stroll to help get the food digestin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Let's keep walkin' for a bit longer. The town's lookin' extra sparkly today.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh wow, it's Tamamo Cross! There she goes!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yep! Happy holidays 'n thanks for all the support!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: So, who's your lucky date?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You dolt, we're not like that! This is just my trainer…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Or maybe not…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You're not just my trainer anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross smiles cheekily.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're part of the fam! My dad knows it, my mom knows it, even the li'l squirts know it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So go on, kids, go 'n tell your friends that Tamamo Cross's family just got a new member!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yup. Anyone that knows me this well is family.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We've already gotten this close, so it's too late for ya to back out now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, let's head on home. We can get all toasty under the kotatsu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Tracen Academy well and truly becomes a home away from home for Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And as a member of that new home, I vow to bring her strength.
